question: How does admin add, update and delete shared items?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour Trip Shared Items
youtubeLink.description: This video explains how to work with trip shared items

sections.title: Add a shared item
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the item belongs to the whole trip and should later be assigned to one participant.
items: Click the Dashboard toolbar button, expand the Trip section and click on the Trips link
Select the trip you want to work in.
Open the Trip section again and select Shared items.
Click the Add button with the plus icon. The Add Trip Shared Item form opens.
Enter the shared item name. You can also fill category, notes, units, and value.
Plantour saves the shared item in that trip and returns you to the Shared items list.

sections.title: Update a shared item
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the shared item already exists and you want to change its details.
items: Open Trip > Shared items for the selected trip.
Select the shared item you want to change so it is highlighted.
Click the Update button with the pencil icon. The Edit Trip Shared Item form opens.
Change fields such as name, category, notes, units, or value.
Plantour saves the shared item and returns you to the list.
sections.afterHtml: Changing who is responsible for a shared item is handled on the Shared items list itself, not in the add or update form. For the assignment workflow, continue with How does admin assign shared items?.

sections.title: Delete a shared item
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the trip no longer needs that shared responsibility.
items: Open Trip > Shared items for the selected trip.
Select the shared item you want to remove so it is highlighted.
Click the Delete button with the trash icon.
Plantour removes the shared item from that trip.
sections.afterHtml: If the item was already accepted by a participant, review the assignment state first. Shared items are tied to acceptance and assignment status, so deleting them is more sensitive than deleting a normal personal trip item.
